Title: Error fetching Jira projects caused by character '@'
Description: I am encountering the following errors when I use the latest version of mcp-atlassian.

Install:
brew install uv
uvx mcp-atlassian

Usage:
Transport Type: STDIO
Command: uvx
Arguments: mcp-atlassian --confluence-url my_url --confluence-personal-token my_token_1 --jira-url my_url --jira-personal-token my_token_2

Error output from MCP server when connecting:
`ERROR - mcp-atlassian - Error fetching Jira projects: Error in the JQL Query: The character '@' is a reserved JQL character. You must enclose it in a string or use the escape '\u0040' instead. (line 1, character 17)`

Seems main features are still correct, I can invoke the tools in windsurf. please help to address the above error.
